node.statement: Provider witnesses and transported constants. Invoke lem-stage1-explicit-group-domain-membership once to fix universal G_d,P_d >= 1 and k_d in (0,1/2]; invoke lem-stage1-explicit-group-closeness once to fix universal G_c,P_c >= 1 and k_c in (0,1/2]; and invoke lem-stage1-polar-retraction once to fix universal P_r >= 1 and k_r in (0,1/2]. Define C_grp^0=max{G_d,8G_c,8}, C_pol^0=max{P_d,P_c,P_r}, and kappa_pol^0=min{k_d,k_c,k_r,1/16}. Then C_grp^0,C_pol^0 >= 1 and 0<kappa_pol^0<=1/2, and these constants are fixed before any receiving def-stage1-polar-witness-data tuple is quantified.
